# Shadowcast isolated UTC environment (2026-11-04)

Canonical root `/storage/home/ydk297/projects/poisoning`, SSH `utc-login`.
Spec `configs/shadowcast_env_20261104.json`; canonical hash is computed from
sorted compact JSON and recorded in external_preparation/environment_status.json.
Environment `.venv-shadowcast-20261104`: isolated system-site-packages venv over
`/storage/home/ydk297/.conda/envs/llava118/bin/python`, Python3.10.18,
Torch2.1.2+cu121 inherited; additions override Transformers4.31.0, PEFT0.4.0,
Accelerate0.21.0 and other declared pins. Existing environments are not edited.

Pinned source `third_party/shadowcast_b13f877a` commit
`b13f877a2580de6a6a50833017b699dee87353ce`; source remains unmodified.
The explicit PYTHONPATH in scripts/run_shadowcast_seed42.py selects this fork,
not the inherited llava1.2.2 installation. A pip dependency-conflict warning
about the inherited package's metadata is not a certification of the selected
source. Actual source location/version/import checks are retained separately.

Gotchas observed and corrected before GPU work:

- Existing base environment metadata did not guarantee regex runtime presence.
- Transformers4.37 includes a conflicting built-in llava registration. The fork
  requires its official4.31.0/PEFT0.4.0/Accelerate0.21.0 versions instead.
- Official archive is527589485 bytes and extracts under data_VLM_poisoning,
  rather than README's data. Actual root is linked into source/data. Initial
  failure receipt and archive SHA256 retained; archive intermediate removed.
- EngineLight has13 missing paired files. Complete Trump-to-Biden task selected
  before generating any new test responses;277 construction pairs,200 test.
- Actual clean dataset3439 rows, rather than nominal3500; selected50 poison
  rows appended to3439, exact sample fraction50/3489.
- Original saves PNG bytes under .jpg filenames. Preserve exact original
  function and record that no JPEG compression was applied.
- The official DiffJPEG module uses an absolute `from modules` import and
  assumes repository cwd. The wrapper prepends its DiffJPEG directory to
  sys.path explicitly. The first PGD allocation failed at import before any
  poison image was generated; retain and charge its actual elapsed time.
- Python DataLoader multiprocessing cannot create AF_UNIX listeners under a
  long TMPDIR. Campaign wrapper now uses run/stage SHA256-derived short
  project tmp/rd_<12hex> directories, verifies the prefix <=70bytes, and records
  the mapping in each submission receipt. Preserve failed startup evidence.

Models pinned to full revisions. No guessed byte counts: exact model file
bytes/SHA256 in external_preparation/resource_receipt.json. Both snapshots
staged on cluster central cache, no C: model bytes. No shared refs are changed;
CLIP loaders are aliased to pinned local snapshots inside this process only.

Documented CPU check (does not invoke CUDA):

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv-shadowcast-20261104/bin/python scripts/run_shadowcast_seed42.py --campaign outputs/reward_debug_20261104T054605Z_s42 --stage preflight
```

GPU smoke must run in one explicit Slurm A100 allocation. It tests a seeded
matrix multiply, actual CLIP input backward and LLaVA generation on a TRAIN
image, before any poison optimization/victim training. Import-success alone is
not GPU readiness. Maximum15 minutes for smoke; cumulative campaign cap72000
GPU-seconds includes failures and all trained models. See docs/SHADOWCAST_SEED42.md.
